column2: Now we can all fit!
No one passes beyond here without Slum King-sama's permission!
Hey, there's nobody at the checkpoint.
Didn't the Slum King lose to Jack and run off?
...I wonder what's past the checkpoint. {s}... I hope she's okay...
...We meet again, {p}.
...You don't remember?\n\nIs this his doing too... Or...?
H-hey, what are you talking about?
You'll understand in time... And that anyone mixed up with me won't walk away clean.
Now the Dragons have come to this town too...
The Reaper Police HQ is southeast of this town. I hope Ayuko-chan is all right...
If you're hungry, I'll feed you till you're stuffed, anytime!
That's weird... It should be right around here...?
Seiji-kun, your father lives in a forest like this?
Nope, right in the middle of a housing area.
This sure doesn't look like a housing area...
Right...? The direction's right, but... there was never any pond near our place...?
Let's walk around a little. If we look around, maybe we'll figure something out?
*Sigh*... Sorry about this...
Huh? The pond southeast of town? Oh, you mean Hasunuma? That pond's been there forever, y'know.
Hasunuma, the pond southeast of town, vanished and a housing area appeared! Or maybe it just feels that way, and it was always a housing area...?
Did you see it? That huge wall past the town! ...The Dragons' checkpoint, you say? What are you on about? That's highway construction.
Something's weird here...
This town is not in Kanto!
Nah, that can't be...
At least, not the Kanto I know.
It's true, there's no sign of the quake anywhere... It looks like an ordinary... yeah, a totally ordinary town. Just like...
...a town from another world!
Come to think of it, I've never heard of any Kanto Hellquake...
If only Papa's death had happened in another world...
Honey...\n\nWhatever world this is, we need to look into it more...
Speaking of weird, I heard something. Someone saw a naked woman around the school! If that's true, how very kekko!
Anything unusual, you ask? The teachers at that school there are all weirdos.
Hey, you there! Will you believe me? I've got an interesting story. Hear me out, okay? Okay!?
Nobody believes me, but...\n\nWould you believe a mansion was floating in the pond!?
A mansion floating in the pond, you say?
Aww, you DO doubt me!!
Sorry, sorry. We don't doubt you, so go on.
Leave the interviewing to me, the newspaper reporter! Hey, kiddo, we don't doubt you, so spill it.
If you don't doubt me, okaaay!
When the mansion floats on Hasunuma, is there some kind of omen?
Now that you mention it, a black moon comes up...
A black moon!?
Eeeeek!!
Did you hear that?
A black moon... that's what he said.
Wanna head back to Hasunuma?
Harenchi Gakuen? Never heard of it...?
Jack, what are you looking at?
Hey hey, somebody's tied up out there.
It's a school, right? Bet he forgot his homework.
Shouldn't we help him?
You think so, {p}...?
Y-yeah...
Then let's go...
Whoaaa!
Kyaaa!
What the!? What the!?
Gahahaha!
Ohohoho! Serves you right, darlings! Trying to rescue Yamagishi? Not so fast, sweet-cheeks! ...Oh my, I thought it was Jubei-chan's lot, but it isn't. They're not even our students!
Let us out, you bastard!
If it's the wrong people, let us out!
Never mind, just toss 'em in, Yoshinaga-sensei!
Ohohoho, you're quite right. They do look savage...
They got the wrong people... Hey, what do we do?
Oh, for crying out loud...!
What a raw deal! That bastard! I'll make him pay!
Where are we...?
Could this be...?
Of all places, they locked us in the bathroom!
...We've got to find some way out of here.
Hiii!
This is... the boys' bathroom! Oh my gosh, silly me!
...Um, who are you?
Oh, sorry.\n\nI'm Mitsuko Yagyu Jubei. Just call me Jubei.
They mistook you guys for me! So I came to rescue you.
Who are those creeps?
Higegodzilla and Marugoshi are teachers at this school.
They're out for payback because everyone picks on them.
I get wanting to pick on them, but they ARE teachers...
But they love it when we pick on them!
That Higegodzilla roped Marugoshi in, and they nabbed Yamagishi-kun.
The guy tied to the post in the schoolyard?
Yep.
Ohh, so that trap was meant to catch you.
Trying to rescue Yamagishi? Not on my watch, darlings!
Hey, Higegodzilla! You got some nerve picking on me! I'll knock your block off!
Eeek!
That's enough, okay?
Huh? Who the heck are you?
I'm {p}.
So you're the one who saved me with Jubei! Thanks! ...Uh, by the way, where's Jubei?
Kyaaa!
Help me, Yamagishi-kuuun!!
Shut it! Make a racket and I'll toss you off!
Noooo!
Jubei! Dammit, Marugoshi!
We've got to save Jubei!
